facts.fact: 再生同款 logo——「Have you seen this before? And if life were only just beginning, how could that be possible?」；闪电穿实验室天花板洞击中尸体、心跳重燃、violent gasp 回黑白身体——「You are the great Chimotera. A puny mob 想终结你的生命是 laughable」
facts.anchor: Life begins again with a logo.

facts.fact: 怒袭与筑新娘：terrorize 无悔但 melancholy 笼罩（缺了什么）——「drink blood like an alcoholic drinks wine；eat vital organs when really eating your feelings；You miss Marcela」；七日造人（skin graft 四夜/bat DNA 注入五夜/第七夜尸体置洞下候雷）——午夜钟声与闪电 tandem（congruency must be fate）——「She returns to you. Bless the power of science. But she is no longer Marcela…The Bride of Chimotera!」；私奔恐怖乡野、mob 再来——新娘举火把「It's not natural. We are not natural creatures. We should never have been born into this existence.」——抱住他点燃共享 effigy——twin monstrosities→skeletal remains seared together——THE END
facts.anchor: You eat vital organs when really you’re just eating your feelings.

facts.fact: 彩色复醒：如预言忘记、回来又全记得；回看黑白世界 absurd（天花板洞闪电？又一场 mob？village 名字连 God 都忘了起）——「home world's insufficiencies self-evident」；Murray's 橱窗换成新电视——「Television. TV.」知识如 galactic encyclopedia 涌入——机器自亮（senses your presence）——glow 比 sun 热、烧 iris、spine tingle、pure ecstatic；TV 自启进入 2009 播报（无旧照段落——旧照属 ch48）
facts.anchor: your home world’s insufficiencies seem self-evident.

facts.fact: 2009 穿透：TV 上 skinny boy 复述 ch02 开场白（11:58pm June 12 2009）——「irrelevant boy」——镜头后女声「It's the end of analog broadcasting」送 fresh chill——「It's her…the true source of the glow」——「You love her immediately. More than you ever loved Marcela. Because Marcela was just black and white. But this girl—she shines」——fever/virulence 唤醒怪物——瞬移 rest stop 浴室地板、clawing at the body below——知道她名字（如知道 television 一词）——「You claw and growl at Erin Morrison, unable to control your passion. worry you might kill her」——闪回结束回到橱窗——内疚（无意施暴于发光女孩）——「no matter how many times you're born and killed」
facts.anchor: It’s her. The girl behind the camera.

facts.fact: 会面二：银幕未亮、闭眼召屏——Fisch 有声（仍黑白）、更大办公室（exposed brick、mantel 新奖座 Disruptor of the Year）——「I am racked with melancholy. You promised I would find love」——「And it happened, didn't it? The Bride of Chimotera! is perfect. A master class in horror. Remembered more fondly than the original. It's in the BFI Top 250!」——「legendary…greatest romances of all time. It will live on forever.」——「Will my bride come back once more?」——「I'm sorry. No. The actress who played Marcela dies in a boating accident before production on the next sequel.」

「I think she was right to crave death——She and I are not natural creatures. We should not exist.」——「We have a term for that kind of talk where I come from: 'Internalized shame.' Wilhelm, you must go on. Don't you want to meet your son?」——「My…son? Another prophecy.」——the catch：「In this meeting ground between your world and mine, have you seen anyone else? On screens, I mean.」——想到 Erin、play dumb 但表情背叛——「Cards on the table: This is what I need your help with.」——「Fine. Yes. I saw someone. She was…majestic. There was a boy there, too, but he didn't matter.」——记笔记问名——「Erin Morrison. I worry she's in trouble.」——「And where does she live?」——「She resides at 140 Darwood Place. Hartsdale, New York 10530. How do I know these things? It seems impossible.」——「It's not impossible. It's innovation.」

机制与任务：「I've conjured this place as a space where the two of us can talk——new process engineered with my team——meeting ground between our worlds. A disturbance, as we like to call it——一点你的+一点我的临时混成」；「你的世界更 vivid/更 real」「In a sense true. But don't put your world down——若我在街上遇见 Erin Morrison，她只是 another girl——unremarkable and camouflaged——但你的视角里她 beams clear as day, glow unmistakable.」——「Why does she glow for me?」——「Because she doesn't actually belong here in my world. So to you she sticks out like a sore thumb, transmits across realities like radar. 很重要：locate all of the people like her——You've been chosen to provide a sacred service to both of our realities.」——「anyone else who glowed?」「No. She was the only one.」——「Fantastic. We're done here, and you get to go meet your son.」——临别：「fair warning. This next entry's kind of a slog. Not the best in the franchise. But there's some really fun stuff coming up in the next few afterwards, so just stay tuned, okay?」
facts.anchor: It’s a new process I’ve engineered
